name: EYE R3 — HIDDEN MACHINE MINER
canonical_law_ru: ИЩИ ОДИНАКОВЫЕ МАШИНЫ, СПРЯТАННЫЕ ПОД РАЗНЫМИ СЛОВАМИ.
target_pipeline: DOCUMENTS -> OPERATORS -> OPERATOR_SEQUENCES -> HIDDEN_MACHINES -> CROSS_DOMAIN_CONSTELLATIONS -> VERIFY
reference_machine: OBSERVE -> FREEZE -> REFERENCE -> BRIDGE -> RECONSTRUCT -> VERIFY -> PRESERVE

penalties.lexical_overlap: Penalize similarity driven mainly by shared vocabulary.
penalties.lineage_overlap: Penalize structures copied or inherited from the same lineage.
penalties.common_operator_penalty: Penalize ubiquitous JANUS operators that are too generic to establish a hidden machine.

falsifier: If structural similarity collapses after removing shared terminology, templates, related lineage and ubiquitous operators, classify the match as MACHINE_ILLUSION rather than HIDDEN_MACHINE.
epistemic_policy: Cross-domain structural analogy is not physical identity. Every proposed bridge requires an independent falsifier and source-specific verification.
